demoName: Demo 2 - Payment between MifosX Green Bank to Mifos X Blue Bank via vNext
demoDescription: Interactive flow showing inter-bank settlement using the vNext protocol bridge.

1.title: Select Origin Bank
1.details: Log in to MifosX Green Bank and select the sender account.

2.title: Initiate vNext Bridge
2.details: Connect the vNext payment bridge to authenticate the destination ledger.

3.title: Confirm Inter-Bank Settlement
3.details: Verify that the funds have been successfully moved and reconciled between Green and Blue banks.
